title: The Zwicky Transient Facility Bright Transient Survey. II. A Public Statistical Sample for Exploring Supernova Demographics (Perley et al.)

episodes.description: Alert filtering, human save/ignore, characterization and spectroscopic follow-up request for one candidate (2019-2020 procedure)

chain.op: 2019 alert filter (magpsf<19, positive subtraction, |b|>7, rbscore, drb, star/bright-star/red-source exclusions, moving-object and minor-planet checks, prior-variability check)
filter run in parallel on GROWTH Marshal and AMPEL
nightly human scanning: ignore definite AGN/variables/artifacts, save the rest
visual inspection of full alert light curve and catalog/imaging cross-matches
classify false positive photometrically/contextually where possible
report to TNS
request SEDM or SPRAT spectrum by priority ranking, reviewed weekly
schedule larger-telescope classical runs for targets SEDM/SPRAT cannot classify
reduce spectra and register classification with TNS within 24 hr
skip if another group already classified reliably

episodes.description: Automated light-curve and context characterization of one saved candidate (BTS Sample Explorer values)

chain.op: download Avro packet data continuously
build g and r light curves from jd, fid, magpsf, sigmapsf, diffmaglim
ignore measurements with limiting magnitude shallower than 19
peak time and magnitude as brightest measurement
rise and fade time to 0.75 mag below peak by linear interpolation
hybrid two-band timescale
Galactic extinction from NED tool
absolute magnitude with distance modulus and uniform K-correction
PS1 (packet) and Lasair cross-matches, star within 1 arcsec
chance-probability galaxy counterpart
SDSS/PS1 catalog host photometry cross-match or hostless upper limit

episodes.description: Admission of one object to the statistical sample

chain.op: cut 1 pre-peak observation 7.5-16.5 d, mlim>19
cut 2 second observation around peak
cut 3 post-peak observation
cut 4 observability 30 d after peak
cut 5 not in reference image
cut 6 AV<1
cut 7 passes latest alert filter
peak between 2018-06-01 and 2020-07-15
purity cut: non-nuclear galaxy cross-match or SN-like timescale
exclude classified star/AGN/false positives to form statistical sample

episodes.description: Volumetric SN Ia and CC SN rates and luminosity functions

chain.op: estimate fsky from exposure history
estimate fext
estimate frec from bright SNe Ia subset
assume fcl vs magnitude
apply Eq. 2 with K-correction
SN Ia rate
CC SN rate with M<-14
upper limits for undetected classes

episodes.description: Host-galaxy colour-magnitude comparison of SN classes

chain.op: restrict to SDSS fields, 0.015<z<0.1
compute host Mi and g-i from probabilistic cross-match plus vetting
subdivide into red sequence, green valley, blue cloud, subdwarf, hostless
inspect imaging of red CC hosts
KS test II vs Ib/c hosts

notes: Per-object branches: E1 4 (B02-B05), E2 5 (B14,B16,B17,B28,B29), E3 3 (B10-B12), E5 2 (B22,B27). Explain branches with rivals named but no rejection (B16,B17,B22) record alternatives without a found negative. No parametric, template or generative light-curve fit anywhere; timescales are interpolation. No per-object practice of predicting later epochs or choosing among model families.
